explication: Rocket.Chat is a secure team-communications platform. Its principal workflow is: a user opens a room, the client loads messages, subscribes to real-time updates, updates cached room state, and renders conversation content. The repository also exposes authentication, invitations, marketplace apps, WebDAV integrations, video-conference controls, federation, authorization, and session handoff. Several server subsystems are represented from directory names and README capabilities; their internal call paths were not sampled, so those relationships are kept minimal or optional.
